title: 第1409章 给仙巴佬开开眼第1408章 继续施工
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
“不想幽王陛下居然亲自来一趟。”
林东方徒步走出城外，迎接幽国国王楚成。
短短不到十天，楚成身上便发生了极为明显的变化。
一道金色的实质化龙影缭绕在楚成身外，这是人气发生质变成的‘皇道龙气’。
十天的亲自开仓放粮，甚至亲手把粮食送到百姓手中，让楚成大大收获了民心，故此发生了蜕变。
有这条皇道龙气护体，他觉得自己在十一境内几乎位于不败之地了。
就连黑甲圣子都得正眼瞧他。
“林道友的黑石城日新月异，我可得好好学学，让我幽国的百姓也过上好日子啊！”
楚成在见到林东方如今的修为后，眼里闪过一丝震撼和忌惮。
他本以为自己凝聚出了皇道龙气就能和林东方掰掰手腕了，可没想到林东方居然发生了如此恐怖的蜕变。
于是他果断换了一套说辞，态度也摆的更低了。
“那可太欢迎楚道友来参观学习了，请进城来看。”
林东方把楚成邀请进黑石城。
刚进城不久，楚成就看到了那座‘黑石城第一百姓医院’。
他这辈子还是第一次见到这种名号的医院。
随后他又注意到了地上的大路。
一条条灰色的坚硬‘石板’路，没有丝毫缝隙。
“这些是丹炉灰渣？”
楚成能闻出这路面上还残存的石灰味道。
每个精通炼丹的人都能闻出来。

“嗯，水泥路，便宜实惠，往后会换成更耐用的沥青路。”
林东方蹦出两个楚成从未听说过的词儿。
回头得去找石油了！
楚成不清楚什么是沥青，但看到百姓的车马以极快的速度通过水泥路，他就清楚的知道了这种路对百姓生活是何等的提升。
他干笑一声说道，“原来道友也是域外来客。”
旁边的黑甲圣子撇撇嘴，他当时是人人喊打的域外天魔，如今林东方就是‘域外来客’！
本地道友真是太双标了。
林东方指向远方一处工地，那里有正在热火朝天干活的工人。
他笑道，“你我都是一个人种，外貌特征相似，语言相通，说域外来客有些见外了吧。”
“按林道友所说，如此更像是兄弟重逢啊！”
楚成一拍手，随后从怀里取出储物袋，找出一条长长的水管来。
这水管直径能有两米多，足够当自来水主管了。
“林道友，这管子可否够用？”
林东方接过管子看了看，无奈摇头。
“这管子品级都接近三境武器了，成本太高，我需要的是无毒耐用，成本低的管子。”
水管的材料必须要无毒，不然就成慢慢要人命的小甜水了。
“楚道友看看我画的草图，这是黑石城目前要用到的管子。”
“我看看…好家伙，居然是每家每户都要连接？”
楚成看到那密密麻麻的管网图后微微一愣。
content_en:
"I didn't expect His Majesty King You to come here in person."
Lin Dongfang walked out of the city and greeted Chu Cheng, the king of You Kingdom.
In less than ten days, Chu Cheng had undergone extremely obvious changes.
A golden dragon shadow lingered outside Chu Cheng's body. This was the 'Imperial Dragon Qi' that became the essence of popularity.
Ten days of personally opening the warehouse to release grain, and even delivering the grain to the people with his own hands, allowed Chu Cheng to greatly gain the hearts of the people, and as a result, Chu Cheng underwent a transformation.
With this imperial dragon energy protecting his body, he felt that he was almost in an invincible position in the Eleventh Territory.
Even the black-armored Holy Son had to look at him.
"Friend Daoist Lin's Blackstone City is changing with each passing day. I have to learn from it so that the people of my country can also live a good life!"
After seeing Lin Dongfang's current cultivation level, Chu Cheng's eyes flashed with shock and fear.
He thought he could compete with Lin Dongfang by condensing the imperial dragon energy, but he didn't expect that Lin Dongfang would undergo such a terrifying transformation.
So he decisively changed his rhetoric and his attitude became even lower.
"Then we welcome fellow Daoist Chu to visit and study. Please come to the city to have a look."
Lin Dongfang invited Chu Cheng into Black Rock City.
Not long after entering the city, Chu Chengcheng saw the 'No. 1 People's Hospital of Black Rock City'.
This was the first time in his life that he had seen a hospital with such a name.
Then he noticed the road on the ground.
There are gray hard stone roads without any gaps.
"These are the ashes of the alchemy furnace?"
Chu Cheng could smell the smell of lime still remaining on the road.
Everyone who is proficient in alchemy can smell it.
"Well, cement roads are cheap and affordable. They will be replaced by more durable asphalt roads in the future."
Lin Dongfang popped out two words that Chu Cheng had never heard before.
We have to go back and find oil!
Chu Cheng didn't know what asphalt was, but when he saw people's cars and horses passing through the cement road at extremely fast speeds, he knew clearly how much this kind of road improved people's lives.
He laughed dryly and said, "It turns out that fellow Taoist is also a visitor from outside the territory."
The black-armored saint next to him curled his lips. At that time, he was an extraterrestrial demon that everyone shouted to beat, but now Lin Dongfang is an 'outside visitor'!
The local Taoist friends really have double standards.
Lin Dongfang pointed to a construction site in the distance, where workers were working in full swing.
He smiled and said, "You and I are of the same race, with similar appearance and features, and the same language. It would be a bit strange to say that we are foreigners."
"According to Fellow Daoist Lin, this is more like a reunion of brothers!"
Chu Cheng clapped his hands, then took out the storage bag from his arms and found a long water pipe.
The diameter of this water pipe can be more than two meters, which is enough to serve as a tap water main pipe.
"Fellow Daoist Lin, is this pipe enough?"
Lin Dongfang took the tube and looked at it, shaking his head helplessly.
"The grade of this tube is close to that of a three-level weapon. The cost is too high. What I need is a non-toxic, durable and low-cost tube."
The material of the water pipe must be non-toxic, otherwise it will become a little sweet water that slowly kills people.
"Fellow Daoist Chu, look at the sketch I drew. This is the pipe currently being used in Black Rock City."
"Let's see... my dear, every household needs to be connected?"
Chu Cheng was slightly startled when he saw the dense pipe network diagram.
